title: PHAYZ
summary: An online store for a t-shirt and hoodie brand, where customers design their own pieces before they buy. We gave PHAYZ a storefront that feels like the brand, and a simple way to run the business behind it.
challenge: PHAYZ wanted customers to personalise hoodies with their own artwork, across the front, back and sides. A standard online store couldn't offer that experience, and the team needed one place to manage products, orders and customers without relying on workarounds.
solution: We created a custom storefront that lets customers upload their artwork, position it on the garment and see exactly what they are ordering. Checkout is simple and secure, with confirmations and invoices sent automatically. Behind the scenes, we built a dashboard where the team manages the catalogue, pricing, orders and customers in one place.
impact: Customers can personalise a product without any design experience
Orders flow from payment to fulfilment with clear status at every step
One dashboard for the catalogue, orders and customers
A foundation the brand can keep building on as the range grows
outcomes: A product personalisation experience made for the brand's customers
Secure checkout with automatic order confirmations and invoices
A simple dashboard for products, orders and customers
technical: Canvas-based design tool with fixed print zones per garment
Razorpay payments with webhook-verified order confirmation
Purpose-built admin CMS for catalogue, orders and customers

title: Tej Computer Services
summary: A redesigned online store for one of Jharkhand's largest trusted distributors of premium computer hardware, gaming accessories and tech solutions. We made it faster and clearer for shoppers, without disrupting how the team works.
challenge: The existing website was slow, hard to extend and didn't reflect the standing of the business. Shoppers found it difficult to discover products and reach checkout, while the team depended on familiar content workflows that couldn't be thrown away.
solution: We rebuilt the customer-facing experience around clearer product discovery, calmer pages and a tighter path to purchase. The team keeps managing products and content the way they always have, while shoppers get a faster, more confident experience that matches the brand's reputation.
impact: A clearer path from discovery to checkout
The team's day-to-day workflow stays unchanged
A solid base for future campaigns and promotions
outcomes: A redesigned storefront that reflects the brand's standing
Easier product discovery and a simpler checkout path
No disruption to how the team manages the catalogue
technical: Headless WordPress backend retained for products and content

title: Kanke General Hospital & Research Centre
summary: A brand website for a hospital, designed to build trust at first glance and make it easy for patients to find the right care and book an appointment.
challenge: The hospital needed a digital presence that felt as capable as its care, not a generic template. Patients had to find doctors and services quickly and see a clear way to book or enquire, while staff needed a site that stayed professional without constant help for routine updates.
solution: We designed a calm, cinematic healthcare website with a strong opening, a simple enquiry form and appointment actions within easy reach. Departments, doctors, gallery and contact details are organised so patients always know where to go next, and the imagery and typography carry the clinical trust the hospital stands for.
impact: A clear first-screen path to book or enquire
A comfortable experience for patients searching on their phones
A visual identity that matches modern hospital standards
Pages ready to grow with new doctors, services and content
outcomes: A brand-led website with clear appointment and enquiry actions
Departments and doctors organised so patients can find care quickly
A polished design that works on every screen
technical: Structured content so staff can keep information current
